source.citation: Chen, L.; Rivas, J.; Rangel, A. (2025), Advancing ECLSS Reliability Modeling: Integrating ISS Data for Sustainable Long-Duration Mission Planning, 54th International Conference on Environmental Systems, ICES-2025-127.
source.extraction_scope: Supplementary manual transcription of 133 component rows from Appendix Tables 2–10, plus 39 remaining Table 1 crew R&R task estimates. The separately validated selected register contains 9 component rows and 2 Table 1 task values; combined coverage is 142 component rows and all 41 task estimates.
limitations: Authors state the reliability database is not yet complete; analogies may be used when data are unavailable.
The appendix does not distribute raw MADS event histories, full exposure denominators, censoring treatment or an independent calibration set.
MTBF, operational MTTR, preventive-maintenance interval/duration, calendar-limited life, throughput-limited life and crew R&R are distinct fields and cannot be interchanged.
Table 1 crew R&R excludes gathering and stowing, depends on installation location/access/task complexity, and is explicitly non-exhaustive.
A repeated Air - IMV fan row in Table 9 is preserved as a second source row and is not treated as an installed quantity.
Blank printed cells remain null, not zero.
No mission probability, system availability, current fleet prediction or flight qualification is derived from these records.
